stem.en: A scientist discovers a new organism that moves by itself and makes its own food by photosynthesis. Which further feature would help place it in Protista?

text.en: Many cells, each with a cellulose wall.

feedback.en: That describes a plant, not a protist.

text.en: One cell with no true nucleus at all.

feedback.en: That describes a prokaryote, which goes to Monera.

text.en: One cell with a wall made of chitin.

feedback.en: A chitin wall points to Fungi, and fungi do not make food.

text.en: One cell with a true nucleus.

feedback.en: Yes. Protista holds single-celled eukaryotes, and Euglena is a protist that moves and makes food.

explanation.en: Moving and making food together do not name a kingdom. The cell does: a single cell with a true nucleus, and no chitin wall, places the organism in Protista.

hints.en: Look at the cell, not at how it behaves.
